news.headline: NeurAxis Announces Medical Coverage Policy Milestone, Expanding Access to Over 18 Million Additional Covered Lives
news.summary: A major national health insurer added medical policy coverage for PENFS (IB-Stim) across multiple states, adding roughly 18 million covered lives and pushing NeurAxis's total national coverage footprint past 120 million lives.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Participate in the Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference
news.summary: NeurAxis will webcast a presentation and hold one-on-one investor meetings at the virtual Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference on September 29-30, with the presentation slotted for 11:45 a.m. ET on September 29.

news.headline: NeurAxis Presents at IAccess Alpha Fall Investment Conference: Payer Wins Drive Growth
news.summary: Management said NeurAxis now has nearly 30 medical policy coverages reaching over 100 million lives (Anthem, BCBS plans, Molina, Medicaid EPSDT in 25-30 states) and reported H1 2026 revenue up 94% to $3.5 million with gross margin near 86%, while flagging state Medicaid fee-schedule gaps and sales-force scale-up as remaining bottlenecks.

news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year-Over-Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: Q2 2026 revenue rose 116% YoY to $1.93 million on expanded PENFS reimbursement following the new Category I CPT code, but EPS of -$0.19 missed the -$0.16 estimate and shares fell roughly 6.8% on the print.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: Additional regional health plan coverage in the Mid-Atlantic added over 500,000 covered lives for IB-Stim/PENFS, which CEO Brian Carrico framed as continued momentum toward comprehensive nationwide written policy coverage.

catalysts.label: Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference
catalysts.detail: Webcast presentation (11:45 a.m. ET, Sept 29) plus one-on-one investor meetings; likely venue for updated payer-coverage and revenue-run-rate commentary ahead of Q3.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Following the Q1 (May) / Q2 (Aug 11) cadence, Q3 2026 results would typically land in November; no official date has been announced yet.

catalysts.label: Nationwide Medicaid EPSDT / CPT code 64567 fee-schedule rollout
catalysts.detail: Coverage already spans 25-30 states via Medicaid EPSDT, but 20-25 states have not yet loaded CPT code 64567 onto 2026 fee schedules; closing this gap (aided by a newly hired VP of market access) is a key near-term revenue lever.

catalysts.label: Adult IBS/FAP multi-site randomized controlled trial readout
catalysts.detail: Six-center RCT (including Cleveland Clinic, Stanford, Indiana University, Hoag, Univ. of Louisville, Marshall University) evaluating PENFS in adult IBS/functional abdominal pain, targeting an estimated $14B combined adult SAM; management guided to usable data in roughly one to two years.

catalysts.label: Series B preferred 8.5% coupon expiration / conversion
catalysts.detail: Management has indicated the 8.5% coupon on Series B preferred shares expires at year-end 2026, after which conversion to common stock is expected, a capital-structure event investors are watching alongside continued opportunistic ATM usage.

pulse: NeurAxis continues to execute on payer-coverage expansion, crossing 120 million covered lives after an 18-million-life national insurer win in mid-September, and is actively presenting its reimbursement and clinical-guideline story at back-to-back investor conferences (IAccess Alpha Sept 15, Lytham Partners Sept 29-30). Fundamentals are inflecting sharply higher (Q2 revenue +116% YoY, H1 revenue +94% to $3.5M with ~86% gross margin) on the back of the new Category I CPT code, though the company remains unprofitable and missed EPS estimates in Q2, with state-by-state Medicaid fee-schedule gaps still capping near-term realization. The bigger long-term catalyst is the ongoing multi-site adult IBS/FAP RCT (Cleveland Clinic, Stanford, and others) targeting a ~$14B adult market, with data still roughly one to two years out.
